paragraphs.source_en: After Okudaira Nobumasa plunged unflinchingly into Mori Nagayoshi’s ranks, word of the attack on Haguro immediately reached Ikeda Shōnyū at Inuyama Castle. Shōnyū shuddered at the unexpected news, but then smiled. “There is no cause for alarm. We settled long ago how to deal with this.” After dismissing the messenger, Shōnyū immediately ordered that his two sons, Katsukurō Motosuke and Sanzayemon Terumasa, be summoned.

units.source_zh: 月光逐渐明亮起来，穷追不舍的敌军武士，头盔和前胸的盔甲熠熠地闪耀着银光，一步步逼向森武藏守。

paragraphs.source_zh: 老天似乎总喜欢跟人开玩笑，武士的话立刻应验——此时，一队骑兵出现在拐角处的竹林旁边。月光逐渐明亮起来，穷追不舍的敌军武士，头盔和前胸的盔甲熠熠地闪耀着银光，一步步逼向森武藏守。

paragraphs.source_en: The castle gates stood wide open before him, and Sanzayemon Terumasa’s men had already formed an impregnable wall of blades and spears at the entrance to await his return. Cursing himself under his breath, Mori Musashi-no-kami swept into the castle like a gale.

units.source_en: The castle gates stood wide open before him, and Sanzayemon Terumasa’s men had already formed an impregnable wall of blades and spears at the entrance to await his return. Cursing himself under his breath, Mori Musashi-no-kami swept into the castle like a gale.
units.source_zh: 他眼前城门大开，三左卫门辉政的部属早已在城门口用刀枪筑起一面铜墙铁壁，等待他归来，森武藏守一面暗暗咒骂自己，一面疾风般冲进了城里。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他眼前城门大开，三左卫门辉政的部属早已在城门口用刀枪筑起一面铜墙铁壁，等待他归来，森武藏守一面暗暗咒骂自己，一面疾风般冲进了城里。

paragraphs.source_en: Bang, bang, bang—a fierce volley of gunfire erupted from the castle at the pursuers close behind.

units.source_en: Bang, bang, bang—a fierce volley of gunfire erupted from the castle at the pursuers close behind.
units.source_zh: “砰砰砰”，一阵猛烈的枪火从城里射向尾随而来的追兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: “砰砰砰”，一阵猛烈的枪火从城里射向尾随而来的追兵。

paragraphs.source_en: More than five hundred of Mori Musashi-no-kami’s routed men poured into the castle, with the troops of Okudaira and Sakai close behind. Terumasa had no choice but to close the gates. Of the common soldiers who had failed to enter in time, some loudly begged for the gates to be opened, while others angrily turned on the enemy. Of course, more than half of those who turned toward the enemy surrendered.

units.source_en: More than five hundred of Mori Musashi-no-kami’s routed men poured into the castle, with the troops of Okudaira and Sakai close behind.
units.source_zh: 森武藏守五百多败退下来的人马涌进了城里，随后追来奥平及酒井的人马。

units.source_en: Terumasa had no choice but to close the gates.

ja.t: ざさないわけにはいかなかった。

units.source_zh: 辉政不想关城门也不行了。

units.source_en: Of the common soldiers who had failed to enter in time, some loudly begged for the gates to be opened, while others angrily turned on the enemy.
units.source_zh: 没有来得及入城的杂兵，有的在大声地乞求开门，有的则愤而转向敌人。

units.source_en: Of course, more than half of those who turned toward the enemy surrendered.
units.source_zh: 当然，转向敌人的士兵们当中，有一大半都投降了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 森武藏守五百多败退下来的人马涌进了城里，随后追来奥平及酒井的人马。辉政不想关城门也不行了。没有来得及入城的杂兵，有的在大声地乞求开门，有的则愤而转向敌人。当然，转向敌人的士兵们当中，有一大半都投降了。

paragraphs.source_en: On seeing how strongly the castle was defended, the pursuers swiftly put their ranks in order and withdrew at their leisure.

units.source_en: On seeing how strongly the castle was defended, the pursuers swiftly put their ranks in order and withdrew at their leisure.
units.source_zh: 追击的一方一看到城防严密，便迅速整理一下队伍，从容地撤回。

paragraphs.source_zh: 追击的一方一看到城防严密，便迅速整理一下队伍，从容地撤回。

paragraphs.source_en: The operation had fully accomplished the aims of Ieyasu, Sakai, and the others. Okudaira Nobumasa alone deeply regretted having failed to slay Mori Musashi-no-kami. Yet with the enemy safely inside the castle, even he dared not launch a reckless assault.

units.source_en: The operation had fully accomplished the aims of Ieyasu, Sakai, and the others.
units.source_zh: 这次作战完全达到了家康和酒井等人的目的。

units.source_en: Okudaira Nobumasa alone deeply regretted having failed to slay Mori Musashi-no-kami.
units.source_zh: 只有奥平信昌一人因为没能斩杀森武藏守而深感遗憾。

units.source_en: Yet with the enemy safely inside the castle, even he dared not launch a reckless assault.

ja.t: けることはできなかった。

units.source_zh: 可是，既然敌人已经逃回城里，他也不敢贸然攻城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这次作战完全达到了家康和酒井等人的目的。只有奥平信昌一人因为没能斩杀森武藏守而深感遗憾。可是，既然敌人已经逃回城里，他也不敢贸然攻城。

paragraphs.source_en: “The enemy has withdrawn completely.” When the sentry descended from the watchtower and hurried to Ikeda Motosuke’s command tent with his report, Motosuke and Musashi-no-kami were both seated on camp stools, looking thoroughly exasperated.

units.source_en: “The enemy has withdrawn completely.”
units.source_zh: “敌人全部撤走了。”

units.source_en: When the sentry descended from the watchtower and hurried to Ikeda Motosuke’s command tent with his report, Motosuke and Musashi-no-kami were both seated on camp stools, looking thoroughly exasperated.
units.source_zh: 当望风的士兵从瞭望台上下来，慌忙赶到池田元助的大帐报告时，元助和武藏守二人都坐在床几上，一副气急败坏的样子。

paragraphs.source_zh: “敌人全部撤走了。”当望风的士兵从瞭望台上下来，慌忙赶到池田元助的大帐报告时，元助和武藏守二人都坐在床几上，一副气急败坏的样子。

paragraphs.source_en: The bonfires all around gradually faded, while the moon climbed higher and bathed the earth in silver light.

units.source_en: The bonfires all around gradually faded, while the moon climbed higher and bathed the earth in silver light.
units.source_zh: 四处的篝火渐渐地淡下去，月亮升高了，银色的月光洒满了大地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 四处的篝火渐渐地淡下去，月亮升高了，银色的月光洒满了大地。

paragraphs.source_en: “Motosuke, was it you who advised my father-in-law that sending aid would be useless?”

units.source_en: “Motosuke, was it you who advised my father-in-law that sending aid would be useless?”
units.source_zh: “元助，是你向岳父进谏，说救援无用？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “元助，是你向岳父进谏，说救援无用？”

paragraphs.source_en: Mori Musashi-no-kami’s interrogation startled and angered Motosuke. “Did we not agree on this from the very beginning? If anything happened...”

units.source_en: Mori Musashi-no-kami’s interrogation startled and angered Motosuke.
units.source_zh: 森武藏守一诘问，元助不禁惊怒。

units.source_en: “Did we not agree on this from the very beginning?

ja.t: わせていたではないか？

units.source_zh: “我们不是从一开始就约好了吗？

units.source_en: If anything happened...”
units.source_zh: 一有情况……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 森武藏守一诘问，元助不禁惊怒。“我们不是从一开始就约好了吗？一有情况……”

paragraphs.source_en: “I do not understand what you mean. We did have an agreement, but what we agreed was that no one would attack without orders. Today I did not launch an attack on the enemy of my own accord; the enemy came to challenge me in broad daylight.”

units.source_en: “I do not understand what you mean.
units.source_zh: “你这话我可不明。

units.source_en: We did have an agreement, but what we agreed was that no one would attack without orders.
units.source_zh: 我们是有约在先，可约定的是不许擅自出击。

units.source_en: Today I did not launch an attack on the enemy of my own accord; the enemy came to challenge me in broad daylight.”

ja.t: めかかったのではない。

units.source_zh: 今日不是我主动向敌人发动进攻，而是敌人光天化日下前来向我挑衅。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你这话我可不明。我们是有约在先，可约定的是不许擅自出击。今日不是我主动向敌人发动进攻，而是敌人光天化日下前来向我挑衅。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Even if the enemy provoked you, you were to withdraw at once... We said that too, did we not? In any case, you have returned safely. Is that still not enough for you?”

units.source_en: “Even if the enemy provoked you, you were to withdraw at once... We said that too, did we not?
units.source_zh: “即使是敌人挑衅，也应立刻撤退……这话也说过吧？

units.source_en: In any case, you have returned safely. Is that still not enough for you?”

ja.t: いずれにせよ、そなたは

units.source_zh: 不管怎么说，你平安地撤回来了，难道还不满？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “即使是敌人挑衅，也应立刻撤退……这话也说过吧？不管怎么说，你平安地撤回来了，难道还不满？”

paragraphs.source_en: “You may be satisfied, but I have lost many of my retainers.” Musashi-no-kami ground his teeth audibly. “That such a thing should happen—Nagayoshi’s heart has grown cold indeed!”

units.source_en: “You may be satisfied, but I have lost many of my retainers.”
units.source_zh: “你可能会满意，我却失去了众多家臣。”

units.source_en: Musashi-no-kami ground his teeth audibly. “That such a thing should happen—Nagayoshi’s heart has grown cold indeed!”

ja.t: らした。「このようなことが

units.source_zh: 武藏守把牙齿咬得咯咯直响，“居然会发生这等事情，真令长可心寒！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你可能会满意，我却失去了众多家臣。”武藏守把牙齿咬得咯咯直响，“居然会发生这等事情，真令长可心寒！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Do you believe we were defeated today?”

units.source_en: “Do you believe we were defeated today?”
units.source_zh: “你是不是以为今天败了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你是不是以为今天败了？”

paragraphs.source_en: “At a time like this, you still have the heart to jest! More than half our officers and men are lost. If that is not defeat, would you call it victory?”

units.source_en: “At a time like this, you still have the heart to jest!
units.source_zh: “都什么时候了，你还有心思说笑！

units.source_en: More than half our officers and men are lost. If that is not defeat, would you call it victory?”
units.source_zh: 我军将士损失大半，不是失败，难道是胜不成？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “都什么时候了，你还有心思说笑！我军将士损失大半，不是失败，难道是胜不成？”

paragraphs.source_en: “And yet we stood by and watched the enemy escape from right under our noses...”

units.source_en: “And yet we stood by and watched the enemy escape from right under our noses...”
units.source_zh: “可是，咱们却眼睁睁地看着敌人从眼皮底下逃走……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “可是，咱们却眼睁睁地看着敌人从眼皮底下逃走……”
